summary: Corrected ImplementationDesign testcase coverage for governed automatic work delegation after IntentDesign re-audit. Coding remains authorized only to update Cursor stage-agent and stage-skill governance surfaces so AUTODEL-DT-00 through AUTODEL-DT-15 pass without weakening existing approval, handoff, audit, commit, or delivery gates. The frozen Harness now checks DT-04 simple one-level work plus DT-04/13 scheduling details, DT-07 evidence locations, DT-09 business synthesis, DT-10 graph-writer/Viewpoint controls, DT-11 dependency ownership, DT-14 hard-trigger decision traceability, DT-15 bounded-summary/no-bypass behavior, and contradictory gate-bypass language. Pre-coding explicit entrypoint evidence is recorded in .argo/temp/automatic-delegation-expected-failures.json; the required pre-commit full runner refresh records baseline evidence in design/KG/test-failure-records.json and runner-owned deliveryStatus.
